column1: # The push gate was run ALONE, at the subject commit, after the pristine
# suite had finished. Every check passed.
# The FIRST run of the push gate in this round FAILED with
#   REASON=aot emitted test-failure markers despite zero exit status
# and the underlying cause was visible in the raw transcript:
#   clang: error: no such file or directory: '/tmp/holyc-asm.s'
# The cause was that the pristine suite was running CONCURRENTLY with the
# gate. The two runs destroyed each other's scratch file. The gate was
# re-run ALONE and every check passed. The pristine runner now takes an
# EXCLUSIVE LOCK on the scratch path.
